collect_note: QCF grantmaking is invitation-only with no open calls, so this watches the news and research page (its server-rendered story blocks; the full list is client-rendered) and keeps only posts that announce an RFP, open call or funding opportunity, so a future open route (the FAQ says alternative models are being explored) is caught. Zero items is expected today.
